findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_query, manage_trigger, update_data_spec, run_data_job, call_dpf_api · Private data: manage_connection, manage_trigger, onboard_data_source, finish_data_source_onboarding, update_data_spec, finish_data_spec_update, run_data_job, finish_data_job, setup_scheduled_pull, call_dpf_api, manage_account, contact · Public sink: submit_query, manage_trigger, onboard_data_source, finish_data_source_onboarding, update_data_spec, finish_data_spec_update, run_data_job, call_dpf_api, manage_account, contact · Destructive: get_status, delete_data_spec, submit_query, manage_connection, manage_trigger, onboard_data_source, update_data_spec, run_data_job, setup_scheduled_pull, call_dpf_api, manage_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_query, manage_trigger, update_data_spec, run_data_job, call_dpf_api · Private data: manage_connection, manage_trigger, onboard_data_source, finish_data_source_onboarding, update_data_spec, finish_data_spec_update, run_data_job, finish_data_job, setup_scheduled_pull, call_dpf_api, manage_account, contact · Public sink: submit_query, manage_trigger, onboard_data_source, finish_data_source_onboarding, update_data_spec, finish_data_spec_update, run_data_job, call_dpf_api, manage_account, contact · Destructive: get_status, delete_data_spec, submit_query, manage_connection, manage_trigger, onboard_data_source, update_data_spec, run_data_job, setup_scheduled_pull, call_dpf_api, manage_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
